scope.summary: Repository-wide Firebase website security scan covering frontend, Cloud Functions, Firestore/Storage rules, hosting config, public forms, CMS rendering, build scripts, dependencies, and secret exposure.
scope.validationMode: static trace, local Node PoCs, npm audit, npm test
limitations: No destructive testing and no live production probing were performed.
Firestore Emulator rule tests were recommended but not run during the audit phase.
External service configuration such as Google Maps key restrictions and Firebase App Check enforcement state in the console was not independently verified.

threatModel.summary: Firebase-hosted public marketing site with public lead forms, Cloud Functions, Firestore-backed CMS content, Firebase Auth admin UI, Storage disabled by rules, and Resend email integration.
assets: CMS public content and admin write capability
trustBoundaries: Browser/client code to Firestore security rules
Public HTTP form submissions to Cloud Functions
CMS-controlled Firestore content to browser rendering
Cloud Functions to Firestore Admin SDK and Resend
Source-controlled build content to generated public HTML
